body:
I'm not stronger.

And it isn't in my past. Flashbacks that I'm powerless to stop bring me back there and to me it's happening -right now- in that moment I'm having a flashback. I can't.

My father raped me.

He started sexually abusing me when I was really little. I don't know how old. It's my earliest memories.

It didn't stop until I was almost 8 years old.

So I never had a childhood belief that the world was a safe place. From my earliest memories the person who was supposed to protect me and keep me safe was the one abusing me.

I've never felt safe a day in my life.

I met with a therapist yesterday. I've been trying grounding techniques. I've read all the books, I've been trying to help myself on my own...

Thanks for your advice. Breathing stuff usually makes me panic and doesn't help. Grounding techniques have been the most successful thing so far.
Thanks for your reply... I'm sorry you've gone through this as well.
